integrality_role: This equal-block projection is the factorial-denominator integrality certificate; it is not probability normalization.
proof: Fix raw gamma in F(T;s,t). For each ordered pair (x,y), gamma contains exactly T(x,y) occurrence slots of x->y.
The T(x,y) distinct proof tokens of type x->y can be assigned bijectively to those slots in exactly T(x,y)! ways.
Assignments for different ordered pairs use disjoint token sets and are independent, so gamma has exactly product_{x,y} T(x,y)! labeled lifts.
Distinct raw histories have disjoint labeled lifts because projection pi retains the full ordered packet history.
Partition LABELED_FIBER by pi and sum the equal projection-fiber sizes.
self_loop_clause: The same slot-permutation argument applies to x->x occurrences, giving T(x,x)! labeled assignments without changing raw packet history.
